Looking at the terrain pattern in that band, it seems shifted down by 7 rows total - the original terrain occupying rows 19-22 now appears at rows 26-29, effectively pushed to the bottom of the 30-row grid. Checking the other rows confirms the same pattern - each terrain block shifts down by exactly 7 rows regardless of column position, landing at the grid bottom. I've worked out the rule:
